name: ChEMBL 37 SQLite/PostgreSQL dump (offline)
adds_beyond_module: Same ChEMBL data without REST outage; adds tables the adapter does not fetch: target_components/component_sequences (gene symbols per subunit), variant_sequences (mutant protein), activity_properties, assay_parameters, activity_stds_lookup, molecule_hierarchy; one SQL join gives compound-target-assay rows with relation, validity, confidence, organism, tissue, cell type
licence_read: CC BY-SA 3.0 (README + LICENSE read 2026-11-01); attribution must state URL and release (chembl_37)
integration_cost_h: 3-5 (download 5.4 GB gz, unpack, read-only queries, one script; no install beyond stdlib sqlite3)
risk: Disk (tens of GB unpacked, unmeasured; 86 GB free); release lag vs REST (37 dated 2026-05-01); share-alike on any redistributed derived table
reopen_condition: Reopen when a task needs a gene-per-subunit or variant-aware potency table across many compounds, or when REST status.json returns 5xx for a task-critical query twice in a day (observed 500 at 2026-11-01 07:37Z). Not downloaded here: no question demanded it

name: Papyrus (05.7, built on ChEMBL 34) + papyrus-scripts
adds_beyond_module: Pre-harmonised compound-protein pairs with AID list, doc_id, relation, Protein_Type (WT or mutations), UniProt accession, quality tier, pChEMBL ensemble stats; useful as a cross-check of ChEMBL-derived potency
licence_read: Data CC BY-SA 4.0 (Zenodo page read 2026-11-01); code MIT (GitHub API spdx); 4TU metadata for older versions inconsistent (CC BY vs CC BY-SA)
integration_cost_h: 6-10 (752 MB xz table, polars/pandas dependency not installed here)
risk: Aggregates per compound-protein pair (assay-level validity comments and per-assay values are not kept); stale (ChEMBL 34 vs 37); pChEMBL-bearing small molecules only; whether heteromeric ion-channel complexes are present was NOT verified
reopen_condition: Reopen if a newer release built on ChEMBL >= 36 appears and a verified check shows heteromeric channel targets (GluN1/GluN2B, GABA-A) are retained with subunit resolution

name: UniChem bulk files (table_dumps, wholeSourceMapping)
adds_beyond_module: Offline cross-reference of ChEMBL/PubChem/GtoPdb/DrugCentral/BindingDB ids by InChIKey connectivity (gap 3) without per-call API
licence_read: NO licence sentence found in FTP READMEs or the gitbook downloads page (read 2026-11-01); EMBL-EBI terms not re-read
integration_cost_h: 4-6 (structure.tsv.gz 13 GB; wholeSourceMapping per source pair smaller)
risk: Licence unverified; 13 GB for structure table; salts/stereo handling still needs a human decision; ChEMBL molecule_hierarchy already gives parent-salt
reopen_condition: Reopen only for a task needing >30 compound id joins across resources not covered by ChEMBL cross-references, and after the EMBL-EBI terms are read

name: ToolUniverse 1.5.8 (ChEMBL_*, GtoPdb_*, UniChem_*, BindingDB_*, OpenTargets_* tools)
adds_beyond_module: Nothing for gaps 1-3 (see tooluniverse_delta.tsv); 1.5.8 adds completeness metadata (PR 824) which would fix the 50-of-100 silent truncation seen in IT3 for the L1000FWD route
licence_read: Apache-2.0 (GitHub licence API 2026-11-01); wrapped services keep their own terms, no licence text returned by tools
integration_cost_h: 0 (no use); 1-2 to re-test truncation only if a signature-reversal question returns
risk: No new question: ChEMBL tools are a REST wrapper of the same API (same 500s); GtoPdb tools read the same bulk CSV the module already uses; ChEMBL activity projection enum is narrower than the adapter (no data_validity_comment, no organism)
verdict: KEEP as optional isolated tool (unchanged); no re-run
reopen_condition: Reopen if a release adds a non-REST ChEMBL backend or returns assay-level fields (validity, relation) with target components, or if the L1000FWD route is needed again (re-check truncation fields)

name: DTA-GNN (leakage audits, scaffold/target splits on ChEMBL)
adds_beyond_module: Defined scaffold-leakage and target-leakage audit procedures and split strategies; can read ChEMBL from local SQLite. Method reference for any future prediction benchmark, not a data source
licence_read: Code MIT (README + GitHub API 2026-11-01); data are ChEMBL (CC BY-SA 3.0)
integration_cost_h: 8-12 for a faithful port of the audits; 0 to cite as method
risk: GNN training stack heavy (not installed); the module makes no affinity predictions, so no consumer exists today
reopen_condition: Reopen if the module starts ranking compounds by a learned score; then reimplement the audit thresholds (read from the Audits page) rather than installing the toolkit

name: SIMPATHIC / rd-explainer (rare-disease repurposing graph methods)
adds_beyond_module: Disease-specific knowledge-graph link prediction with explanation subgraphs for rare disease; neuromuscular (SIMPATHIC) not neurodevelopmental
licence_read: Code Apache-2.0 / MIT (GitHub API 2026-11-01); data licences NOT read
risk: Predicts from graph topology; drops assay context, the thing the module must retain; papers and code not read beyond abstract-level search results
reopen_condition: Reopen if a method paper shows context-retaining (assay/species/target-complex) edges and a held-out evaluation on neurodevelopmental channelopathies, read in full text
